title: Australian officer says Buchanan also knocked out Australian computers
place_text: Bureau of Indian Affairs cafeteria; Australia

tellings.quote: You know, you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia."

plain: A former US Army sergeant, Lyn Buchanan, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an earlier incident in which computers were said to have failed because of him. He says that years later, in a cafeteria at the Bureau of Indian Affairs, a US government agency, an Australian officer came up and told him: "you're the one that knocked out our computers over in Australia." If true, it would mean whatever power he had reached far beyond the first incident.
